source: Generated assistant-register responses to plain user questions
known_limitations: A single model and a single point in time. The baseline is what this model wrote on this date; another model's defaults differ, which is why every profile records the baseline version.

Responses that were mostly bullet lists were excluded, because copyme's features are prose features and a list has no paragraph shape to measure. This makes the baseline a prose baseline specifically.
Prompts are questions, so the register is explanatory. Model output in other modes -- drafting, summarising to a brief, writing in a persona -- is not represented.
